title: Compare the mechanisms in the same task evaluation
method: Synthetic held-out set of 60 troubleshooting questions. Supported-answer rates are 55%, 75%, and 80%. The final configuration combines techniques; the chart does not imply independent or additive gains.
alt: Compare the mechanisms in the same task evaluation. Prompt baseline: 33 supported answers out of 60, Retrieval added: 45 supported answers out of 60, Adaptation + retrieval: 48 supported answers out of 60. Illustrative data.
